info.title: ARCANOS Gaming Custom GPT Action
info.description: Builder-specific contract for ARCANOS Gaming. Public gameplay query and canary operations remain separate from authenticated source ingestion, refresh, and status capabilities.

post.description: Submit a Gaming request and up to four untrusted candidate URLs for ARCANOS to fetch and validate.

payload.prompt: Look up a concise beginner guide for Elden Ring.
Look up a current beginner-to-midgame guide for Palworld 1.0.

200.description: Gaming result, including a controlled evidence request when current evidence is unavailable.

400.description: Malformed or invalid request expressed as bounded JSON.

500.description: Unexpected route failure expressed as bounded JSON.

post.summary: Verify the public ARCANOS Gaming Action pipeline
post.description: Run a deterministic, non-administrative canary over public request validation, dispatch, bundled fixture grounding, response construction, and response guarding.

200.description: The deterministic public canary completed successfully.

400.description: The public canary request was malformed or invalid.

500.description: The public canary response failed a bounded construction or guard stage.

503.description: The public canary fixture or public pipeline is temporarily unavailable.

post.description: Submit one to four public HTTPS source URLs for authenticated asynchronous validation, extraction, normalization, deduplication, and storage.

202.description: The ingestion was accepted or idempotently replayed.

400.description: The closed ingestion request was malformed or invalid.

401.description: A valid Gaming source bearer credential is required.

403.description: The authenticated credential lacks the Gaming source write scope.

409.description: The idempotency key is already bound to a different request.

422.description: No submitted source passed admission validation.

429.description: The authenticated Gaming source request budget was exceeded.

500.description: The ingestion could not be queued because of an internal failure.

503.description: Gaming source ingestion is temporarily unavailable.

post.description: Queue authenticated refresh work for one to four previously admitted Gaming source IDs without accepting a replacement URL or changing trust state.

202.description: The refresh was accepted or idempotently replayed.

400.description: The closed refresh request was malformed or invalid.

401.description: A valid Gaming source bearer credential is required.

403.description: The authenticated credential lacks the Gaming source write scope.

409.description: The idempotency key is already bound to a different request.

422.description: No requested source ID passed admission validation.

429.description: The authenticated Gaming source request budget was exceeded.

500.description: The refresh could not be queued because of an internal failure.

503.description: Gaming source refresh is temporarily unavailable.

get.description: Read a sanitized authenticated status projection for one Gaming source ingestion or refresh; no generic job, queue, worker, or database state is exposed.

parameters.name: ingestionId
parameters.description: Opaque ingestion UUID returned by an accepted ingest or refresh operation.

200.description: Sanitized ingestion lifecycle and source-level status.

401.description: A valid Gaming source bearer credential is required.

403.description: The authenticated credential lacks the Gaming source read scope.

404.description: The ingestion is absent or unavailable to this capability.

429.description: The authenticated Gaming source status budget was exceeded.

500.description: The sanitized ingestion status could not be constructed.

503.description: Gaming source status is temporarily unavailable.

bearerAuth.description: Required only for Gaming source ingestion, refresh, and status operations.

GamingIdempotencyKey.description: Unique key for one semantic request; reuse it only when retrying that same request.

sourceTypeHint.description: Untrusted classification hint; ARCANOS determines the stored source type.
